info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Operational Services Processing Order-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Operational Services Processing Order API facilitates the submission and management of operational service orders within the banking ecosystem. This API enables financial institutions to create processing orders efficiently, streamlining order fulfillment and operational workflows. Typically utilized by banking personnel and operational teams, it empowers them to initiate, track, and update service requests as necessary. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their operational capabilities, ensuring timely and accurate service delivery.

post.description: Initiates the processing of an operational order by submitting the necessary details. This endpoint is used to manage order processing effectively within the operational services framework.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for processing an order through the operational services. It should contain all the necessary data required for the order processing, ensuring that the format adheres to the specifications outlined in the schema.
